newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, now on a visit to the United States, urged U.S. entrepreneurs to "utilise the investment opportunities" created in Bangladesh following installation of her government. "Utilise the opprtunity... be partners of progress of Bangladesh," she told them in New York.
Bangladesh's opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia, now on a visit to Saudi Arabia, has advocated better relations among the South Asian countries by strengthening the seven-nation SAARC forum.
Bangladesh Telephone and Telegraph Board (BTTB) has said it has no pan to raise telephone call rates.
A Hong-Kong firm has expressed interest to set up a $45 million soda ash plant in Chittagong.
A 20-member British trade mission is due to arrive in Dhaka on Friday to explore business and investment opportunities in Bangladesh.
